newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June light vehicle sales fall 3.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June light vehicle sales fall 3.4 percent.

text.p: U.S. car and light truck sales during the month of June totaled 1,326,385 units with all automakers reporting, a 3.4 percent decline from the 1,373,451 units sold a year earlier.

The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for the month was 14.25 million units, down from 14.81 million units a year earlier and 14.84 million units for the month of May. The rate is calculated with seasonal factors supplied by the U.S. Commerce Department.
Automakers sold 611,684 North American-built cars in the United States in June, down eight percent from a year ago.
The seasonally adjusted annual rate for domestic cars was 6.5 million units, compared with 7.06 million in June 1996 and 6.65 million in May.

Automakers sold 540,192 domestic trucks in the United States during June, down 0.6 percent from a year earlier. The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for domestic trucks was 5.79 million units, compared with 5.89 million a year earlier and 6.2 million in May.

Imported car sales totaled 129,764 units, up two percent from a year ago, with a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.45 million units. Imported truck sales rose 19.6 percent to 44,745 units for an annual rate of 51,000 units.
